messages:
deploy-bot: [deploy 1733333333] post-deploy smoke run for release/edge-api v2 -> canary eu1 completed. Summary: 94% ok, 6% errors (mostly 503). Synthetic probe eu1-embed-synth p95=420ms, 503-rate=6%, failing prefills. Dashboard: https://releases.redwood/inbox/1733333333 :eyes:
maria: seeing the same in dashboards — p95 jump on /embed route. Is this just transient warmup or something else?
kai: looks like KV prefill lagging. Warmup tasks are queueing and hosts show short memory spikes during model load. Could be prefill parallelism cap.
sam: quick grep from canary host logs:
```
[2026-03-15T12:01:23Z] ERROR 503 ServeRequest failed: cache_miss -> model_load_timeout
[2026-03-15T12:01:24Z] WARN PrefillQueue length=42
```
jen: recommend PAUSING the rollout for now. Options: A) pin canary to previous image (v2.3.1) to stop new hosts from warming; B) increase warmstart parallelism and re-run probes. Thoughts?
alex: +1 to pin. We've hit the same pattern before — warmstart pressure -> short 503 bursts. Pin is fastest mitigation.
maria: can someone run a targeted replay on the failing sample keys? want to confirm reproducibility before deciding. I can run a small replay set.
sam: running replay (n=200) against canary sample set now. preliminary: avg error ~5.5%, reproduces the spike.
infra-bot: autoscaler: scaled +2 nodes at 12:03:18, pods provisioning; but runtime logs still show model_load in progress for several pods.
maria: @deploy-bot please freeze any further traffic shifts. @kai @alex can you own the pin if needed?
deploy-bot: rollout status: STAGED -> traffic split frozen. Runbook: if synthetic error >3% for 5m, holdpoint engaged.
kai: I'll try bumping warmstart concurrency from 2 -> 4 and re-run warmup probe. If probe clears in 10m we can consider resuming; otherwise pin.
jen: agree — prefer pin if warmstart tweak doesn't resolve quickly. post-deploy user impact is small but we should avoid regressions.
alex: pinned canary to v2.3.1 and reverted traffic split to pre-release ratio. Observability: 503-rate down to 0.8% over last 60s and p95 trending back to baseline. :thumbsup:
maria: thanks — replay will keep running for 20m. Opening follow-up: INF-2026 to investigate model load sequencing and prefill backpressure (assign infra+runtime).
sam: created INF-2026: "canary warmstart surge causes 503s during postdeploy" — linking to release notes and this thread.
deploy-bot: release/edge-api v2 rollout PAUSED and canary pinned to v2.3.1. Follow-ups: INF-2026. Marking rollout decision complete. :white_check_mark:
